source: DOF Parking Violations Issued FY2020-FY2027, camera codes per the DOF code table (ncbg-6agr): 36 photo speed, 7 red light, 5 bus lane. Cameras with a named or recoverable cross street are placed at the exact crossing. Corridor records whose cross street the City’s 20-character field cut off are apportioned fractionally along the named corridor, weighted by street length inside each district, across all layers including precincts and sectors. The apportioned share per layer per year is stored.
